Description

The lipoxin A4 receptor is expressed on spinal astrocytes. Spinal lipoxin A4 and its stable analogues attenuate inflammatory pain and the activation of ERK and JNK in astrocytes (Svensson 2007).

Colour

Red raises pain, blue relieves it, and olive acts both ways. Each molecule is coloured by its role in this block.

Lipoxin A4 and its receptor are blue.

References

  1. Svensson CI, Zattoni M, Serhan CN. Lipoxins and aspirin-triggered lipoxin inhibit inflammatory pain processing. J Exp Med. 2007 Feb 19;204(2):245-52. doi: 10.1084/jem.20061826. PMID: 17242163.
